summary: Plain kerb where cars park, but apartments sit 13-26 m behind on this side.

drivers.seclusion: Apartments and terraces 19-26 m away on the same side, more homes across the road; homes within 25 m all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside lane where cars park in the imagery; room to pull in beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Through street with steady traffic; apartments and houses either side.
drivers.convention: Cars parked along both kerbs in QLD imagery, so a van will not stand out; No Stopping Mon-Sat afternoons and half-hour parking signs apply by day.

flags: Dwellings 9-19 m from kerb further south (at 18-90 m)
sun_shade: Open to the sky, tree canopy on the verge to the west; afternoon sun from the west blocked by buildings.

best_section.where: Station Road west kerb, north end beside the leafy verge strip
